# v2.65 Release Notes

This stable release rolls up dev pre-release **v2.65-dev**. It rounds out the
**"Last imported"** timestamps shown across the app and makes them company-aware
on the company-scoped pages.

## New / Fixed: "Last imported" now shows on more screens

Several admin screens show a **"Last imported: <date/time>"** line in their header so
you can tell how fresh the data is. A few were missing it — this release fills the gaps:

- **Admin › Program Data** — the header already had the line, but nothing ever recorded a
  program-data import, so it was **always blank**. Running a Program Data import now stamps
  the time, and the header shows it.
- **Admin › Offerings** — now shows a "Last imported" line in its header (it had none before).

(Specialisations and System Settings › Import Aliases already showed this — they're
unchanged; their timestamp appears once you've actually imported that data.)

## Improved: Students & Offerings show the last import for the selected company

The **Students** page previously showed a single, system-wide "last imported" time. It now
shows the last import for the **company you've selected** in the header. If you're viewing
**All companies**, it shows the most recent import across the whole system, exactly as
before.

The new **Offerings** timestamp works the same way — it reflects the selected company (and
the system-wide latest under "All companies"), since offerings belong to a single company.

If a specific company has never had an import, the line is intentionally **blank** for that
company — a truthful signal that nothing has been imported for it yet, even if other
companies have.

## Notes

- No database migration and no configuration changes.
